description: Safe Drinking Water Facilities Information System for Pennsylvania 2018 - Current Environmental Protection is a dataset listed in Commonwealth of Pennsylvania open data portal (data.pa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) is EPA’s national database that manages and collects public water system information from states, including reports of drinking water standard violations, reporting and monitoring violations, and other basic information. The data derived in the State of Pennsylvania is published and searchable online on the www.pa.gov website. Coverage: Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the category Energy and the Environment. Its tags are facility, safe, sdwis, environment, drink. The table has 37 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Environmental Protection. The portal shows 2019-08-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-pa-gov-portal.
